entries.en: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu is a believer in equal opportunities.
entries.fr: L'éboueur Bo Bu a été frappé par un éclair de génie. Vous n'allez probablement pas tarder à savoir de quoi il s'agit... et ce que vous allez devoir faire.
entries.ja: 第789洞穴団の採掘地のダストマン789 ボ・ブは、ただしたいことがあるようだ。

entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Bo Bu, proving to be among the more spirited kobolds at the dig, dismisses the vaunted abilities of Zo Ga and his followers, asserting that their strength is merely the product of superior resources paid for with ill-gotten wealth. To test his theory, he would “borrow” some crystalline saltpeter from the 13th Order's stores in U'Ghamaro, and deliver it to the 789th's own Ba Go, to see what destructive wonders the acolyte might fashion from such prime material. Or rather, he would have you do this─there is a limit to the dustman's courage, after all.

entries.en: Neither applause nor accolades were to be had, but rather expletives and epithets, as Ba Go took considerable umbrage at the mere implication─voiced by no one in particular─that the work of Zo Ga's alchemists was somehow superior to his own. Break the news to Bo Bu, and try to be gentle about it.
entries.fr: Bien que touché par votre cadeau inattendu, Ba Go vous a expliqué que  servent à nourrir (si c'est le terme qui convient) les grenados, et non les bombos qu'il élève. Allez donc expliquer ça à ce cher Bo Bu.

entries.en: 789th Order Dustman Bo Bu, showing admirable pluck, is not shaken by Ba Go's disapproval─perhaps because he did not hear it─even resolving to someday apprentice himself to the eccentric genius and hone his own bombcrafting skills. Who are you to dash the young lad's dreams?
entries.fr: Vous n'avez pas eu le temps de raconter ce qui s'est passé à l'éboueur du 789e ordre, car génial comme il est, ce dernier vous a révélé qu'il était de son devoir de mettre son intelligence supérieure au service des autres... notamment quand ça implique de faire faire le sale boulot à quelqu'un de serviable comme vous.
entries.ja: ダストマン789 ボ・ブに報告した。彼はアコライト789 バ・ゴが自分に感謝していると、信じて疑っていないようだ……。ともあれ、仲間の役に立とうとする心意気を買って、また協力してあげよう。
